meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会组建一个由3名漏洞猎人和2名PoC工程师组成的安全研究团队，并行审计代码库，确认漏洞的可利用性，分类根本原因，并根据实际可利用情况调整严重性等级。
howto.when: 当用户提到“安全研究”、“安全审计”、“漏洞审计”等关键词，或要求进行安全审查、威胁模型验证时触发。

say.text: 对我这个仓库做一次安全研究。
say.note: Claude 会启动团队模式，并行审计当前仓库。

say.text: 审计这个PR的漏洞，并给出PoC。
say.note: 将针对PR的变更进行安全审计并尝试复现漏洞。

say.text: 检查当前分支的安全风险。
say.note: Claude 会比较当前分支与上游的差异，进行安全审查。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude orchestrates a team of 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity based on actual exploitability.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'security research', 'security audit', 'vulnerability audit', or asks for security review, exploitability audit, or threat model validation.

say_en.text: Run a security research on this repository.
say_en.note: Claude starts a team-mode parallel audit of the repo.

say_en.text: Audit this PR for vulnerabilities and provide PoCs.
say_en.note: The PR changes will be audited and PoCs attempted.

say_en.text: Check the security risks on the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude diffs the branch against upstream and performs security review.
